branches.conclusion: The complete current postgraduate finder lists a Doctor of Business Administration, rather than a business PhD or a named Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering doctoral specialization. DBA remains a separate degree category under the standing scope.

The complete current postgraduate finder lists PhDs in Engineering Management and Intelligent Systems Engineering. Both individual official programme descriptions were opened. Engineering Management describes broad technical and managerial research but has no named qualifying Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering specialization. Intelligent Systems Engineering describes AI, robotics and intelligent technologies; its September 2025 brochure lists only those areas and no qualifying named specialization. The Industrial Engineering degree shown in the central finder is a bachelor's, not a doctorate.
